findings.summary: what_happened states the wrapper 'hit its 30 min default timeout' as fact.
findings.trigger: Reader takes what_happened at face value.
findings.consequence: Cause presented as established. Evidence is [killed] marker plus root-reported 1825.8 s wall time; audit.json itself says only 'consistent with'. Terminating mechanism is unproven.
findings.fix: Reword to: stopped with [killed] at ~1826 s wall, consistent with the 30 min default timeout (root-reported); sleep correlation not signal proof.

findings.summary: Several audit.json booleans/strings are literals, not computed: parent324_unchanged, checkpoint_equals_accepted_constant_via_validate_static, original_summary_preserved (262), unstarted_paths_untouched (265), planned_training_endpoints_complete (264), final_integrity_checkpoint text (213), progress_last_mtime_local (242).
findings.trigger: Script runs with these fields hardcoded to True or fixed strings.
findings.consequence: Values are true at review time, but the script does not check them. parent324 is only supported indirectly (receipt sha at line 134 and checkpoint constant at line 133). original_summary_preserved and unstarted_paths_untouched were not checked. Labels overstate what the script proved.
findings.fix: Compute them, or relabel as expected-value notes. Review verified by read: operator-summary sha matches; replica-3 dirs have no launch artifacts.

findings.summary: release() writes state via tempfile.mkstemp, so state.json is now mode 0600 (-rw-------). Sibling v2-orchestration files are 0644. Pre-release mode not recorded.
findings.trigger: Any normal mkstemp-based write (also used by binding.save, which gives registration-final.json 0600).
findings.consequence: Likely benign and possibly pre-existing, but the release receipt does not record pre-release mode or pre-release hash, so 'unrelated state preserved' is supported only by in-process before/after check, not a receipt.
findings.fix: Record pre-release sha and mode in the next receipt; restore mode only if the original is known. Do not blind-restore.

findings.summary: release() re-proves process absence and lease identity but does not re-hash the evidence snapshot before clearing the lease.
findings.trigger: Evidence changes between audit and release (none observed; snapshot still matches now).
findings.consequence: Lease-clear is bound to the audit hash but not to current evidence state. No effect on this run because I verified evidence unchanged after release.
findings.fix: Optional: compare current snapshot to audit evidence_snapshot before clear.

findings.summary: Audit does not state the sleep-to-active-clock arithmetic or the post-wake progress alert timing.
findings.trigger: Reader wants to know why active time is ~110 s while wall is ~30 min.
findings.consequence: Explanation is implicit. Post-wake progress-alert.json (01:27:19 local, elapsed 226.59 s awake) implies about 116 s awake after the 01:25:23 wake with no progress rows. Shows workers did not resume output after wake, but cannot distinguish killed-at-wake from died-in-sleep.
findings.fix: Add the arithmetic and alert timing as explicit correlation, labelled as such.
